text:
Priya Natarajan: Quick org update 2b — Ravi Patel (Head of Runtime) will be taking a planned sabbatical starting 2026-04-15 for ~12 weeks. During that time we'll split the Head of Runtime responsibilities into two interim leads to reduce single-owner risk: Zoe Kim will act as Interim Runtime Infrastructure Lead and Marcus Lee will act as Interim Runtime Delivery Lead.

Ravi Patel: thanks all 2b. I'll be around next two weeks for handoff docs and async Qs. super grateful to Zoe & Marcus for stepping up.

Zoe Kim: happy to take infra ops ownership. immediate priorities: capacity planning for Dedicated pools, kernel rollout schedule, and on-call transition. will post a 7-day handoff checklist later today.

Marcus Lee: i'll own service-level routing, rollout cadence, and runtime delivery ops. planning to run a cross-functional sync Wed 9am PT to capture outstanding rollout items.

Patrick (Recruiting): noted 2b. This creates three temporary hiring actions: (1) Contract Eng Lead (infra) for 12w, (2) Senior Runtime PM (6+ month contract), (3) Coverage ICs for on-call shifts. Target: post Contract Eng Lead by EOW, PM next week. I'll spin up reqs and propose panels.

Sam (Runtime IC): +1 to recruiting timeline. recommend a 2-day shadow for infra contractors and at least one paired pager duty transfer with the current on-call before handoff.

Peter (Finance): heads-up: contractor budget for eng lead approved up to 12w at current staffing rates. PM headcount requires director-level headcount sign-off. loop me before offers.

Jules (Legal): if any contractors need access to customer data or private repo, legal/nda team needs notice 48h before onboarding.

Lina Chavez: can we add a short 1-page runbook for the interim on-call rotation? I can draft with Sam if helpful.

Priya Natarajan: yes please Lina 2b. also we'll schedule a 30/60 check-in cadence with Diego and Ravi's skip-level sponsor.

Recruiting Bot: New postings created: Contract Eng Lead (infra) [req-9876], Senior Runtime PM (req-9877). Candidate pipeline links: https://recruiting.redwood/req-9876, https://recruiting.redwood/req-9877

Patrick (Recruiting): proposed interview panel for Contract Eng Lead: Zoe, Sam, one infra architect, and a cross-team SRE. PM panel: Marcus, Product PM, and one customer-facing engineer. share feedback rubric by EOD.

Zoe Kim: i'll add infra architect suggestions to the panel and draft a short take-home exercise (20-40m) focused on capacity tradeoffs.

Marcus Lee: PM take-home will be scenario-based: rollout with degraded region + model fallback. aim for 45m.

Priya Natarajan: Onboarding notes: please ensure access requests are pre-approved for contractors (Confluence, infra dashboards, PagerDuty). Kayla/People Ops will coordinate.

Onboarding Bot: Interim lead onboarding checklist for Zoe Kim and Marcus Lee started. Items assigned:
- Handoff doc uploaded to Confluence (Ravi)
- PagerDuty overlaps scheduled (Sam)
- Access requests queued (People Ops)
- 30/60 agenda template assigned

Priya Natarajan: We'll cross-post to #eng-runtime, #eng-sre, and #product for visibility. If you want to volunteer for panels or help with handoffs, ping Patrick or me. Thanks everyone for the quick response :tada:

Ravi Patel: one small ask 2b: any lingering feature flags or rollback windows that need to be extended during my sabbatical, let's mark them in the tracking doc so Marcus can triage. doc: https://redwoodintra/confluence/runtime-sabbatical-handoff

Patrick (Recruiting): I'll DM volunteers for panels tomorrow and share calendar invites. ETA for first contractor start is 2026-04-20.

Priya Natarajan: last note 2b: this is a planned sabbatical; Ravi will return in mid-July. We'll treat these hires as time-bound unless a different business need is surfaced. Any questions, reply here or ping me directly.
